title: Quotas alone never stop a test
statement: End an adaptive test only when its minimum length, content quotas and precision target are all met, under a hard cap, so meeting the quotas alone never stops it.
example: Under that rule one engine's sessions averaged 40.6 items: 76.5% stopped at the 40-item floor, 15.1% ran to the 43-item cap and none stopped below 40.
detail: A reading assessment's earlier exam spec ended a session once 39 items were given with the quotas and the floor for technology-enhanced items met, whatever the precision, or early from 20 items once the standard error reached 0.30 logits (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/map-proxy-assessment/reference/CAT_MAP_EXAM_SPEC.md`). Its later configuration lets a session end only when the 40-item scored floor, the quotas, that floor and a standard error of at most 0.35 logits are all met, with items 41 to 43 as a band for extra precision and 43 as a hard cap (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/map-proxy-assessment/validity/01_PSYCHOMETRIC_DESIGN.md`). In the full-bank validation sessions averaged 40.6 items, 76.5% stopped at exactly 40, 15.1% ran to the cap and none stopped below 40, which the package reads as quota-only stopping removed (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/map-proxy-assessment/validity/03_SIMULATION_EVIDENCE.md`).
against: The change was made to match another engine's configuration, not because a gain was measured: the 0.35-logit stop, checked only from 40 items, replaced 0.30 with an early stop from 20 items (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/map-proxy-assessment/validity/01_PSYCHOMETRIC_DESIGN.md`).

evidence.quote: a session may end only when the scored floor, the quotas, the TEI floor, *and* the SE target are all satisfied — quotas alone never stop the test.
In the v4 validation, sessions averaged 40.6 items: 76.5% stopped at exactly 40 (SE ≤ 0.35 met at the scored floor), 15.1% ran to the 43-item hard cap, and no session stopped below 40.
